purpose: Project game sprite asset, not real-event appearance evidence
mode: generate new identities with existing illustration style reference
note: Actual figure bounds are calculated from alpha rather than assumed equal cells. Some action pairs are similar; these are painted poses plus runtime body motion, not a rigged crowd or twelve new complete animation clips.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: new transparent sprite atlas for an existing bright painted Ghe Ngo festival game. The input sheet is ONLY a style reference (soft illustrated figures, warm readable outlines, friendly natural faces); ignore its brown background and create brand-new people. Create ONE PORTRAIT PNG with true alpha transparency, exactly 4 columns by 6 rows of individual full-body figures, 24 separate cells, equal spacing, no grid lines or labels. Each row holds TWO new identities, each shown twice in adjacent cells: columns 1/2 are the same person in calm and animated cheering poses; columns 3/4 another person in calm and animated poses. Feet remain at the same baseline within each pair, same clothing and face and scale; leave generous transparent gutters and keep raised hands entirely inside their cell. Bright daylight, softly painted game illustration with readable silhouettes and realistic natural human proportions, no heavy shadows, not photorealistic. This is a mixed family crowd from the Mekong Delta. Rows 1-3 face the viewer at a gentle elevated 3/4 bank camera: row1 brown short-sleeve shirt adult man, waving open hand / orange patterned blouse adult woman, clapping; row2 white-haired older woman in a green floral blouse and black trousers, smiling with hand raised / gray-haired older man in a checked blue shirt and loose dark pants, arm raised cheering; row3 teenage girl in lavender T-shirt and dark trousers, pointing toward the boats / young boy in a pale green T-shirt and blue shorts, delighted clapping. Rows 4-6 show BACK or rear 3/4 view, looking away toward the river: row4 adult woman with bun and blue floral shirt, waving / older man with gray hair in a cream shirt and olive trousers, hand raised; row5 adult man wearing a forward red baseball cap and charcoal shirt, both arms cheering / woman wearing a sunhat and yellow blouse, applauding; row6 child in a blue T-shirt and orange shorts, pointing / teenage girl with a ponytail and coral shirt and gray trousers, raising a smartphone to film. All people wear appropriate casual trousers, skirts or shorts and sandals or sneakers; varied hair and faces, credible hands. Keep the SAME character identity in each pose pair. No crowd scene, environment, river, ground, flags, signage, text, duplicates across identities, furniture or crop. Crisp full-body cutouts on genuinely transparent background. Draw the figures in the existing reference's cohesive soft illustration style, suitable for two banks full of dense varied cheering spectators.
